title: Recycling & Waste: Material Streams
welcome_lead: Different materials go through different recycling journeys.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: paper, glass, metal, plastic recycling.
final_note: Sort carefully and the system works.

walkthroughs.body_html: Old paper is pulped, cleaned and rolled into new sheets. Fibres get shorter each time, so paper can be recycled about 6-7 times.
Glass and aluminium can be recycled forever without losing quality. Recycling aluminium uses 95% less energy than making it new.
Plastic has many types. Bottles (PET) recycle easily. Soft films often don't. Check labels and your local rules.
